variants.headline: Assembly votes the government out
variants.body: The Colonial Assembly has voted the government out in {colony}. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: Confidence withdrawn
variants.body: The government has been voted out by the Colonial Assembly. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: Office meets its parliamentary limit
variants.body: An Assembly vote has removed the government in {colony}. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.
